Subject: Timeline lock & stage refresh — sprint sweep (StellarHealth + near-term deals)

Team,

Finance asked us to complete a quick pipeline hygiene sweep for the deals with close dates inside Q4 planning. We need either a firm timeline lock (confirmed date + owner ok) or reclassification to an "uncommitted / hold" state for any opportunity that can't meet the date. This is specifically to avoid last-minute forecast churn on the 10/15 forecast submission.

I've attached a snapshot (Q4_pipeline_timeline_refresh_20271002.xlsx) with the subset of deals across our book that are high-variance for the quarter — please focus first on the StellarHealth opportunity (RDW-5278-SH) and the three others listed on tab 1.

Action items (please):
- Owners: confirm the close date in Salesforce and set the Stage to either Commit / Commit - At Risk / Requalify / Archive by EOD Friday 10/08. If you've already updated, reply with the SF link.
- If the deal needs to be pushed beyond 10/31, mark the expected close and add a one-line reason in the SF notes (procurement, budget cycle, legal).
- Marcus: flag any deals you think should be archived this quarter (we'll triage).

Why this matters: Finance needs a stable top-line for the mid-month forecast and we want to avoid overstating commit. A short nudge now saves us an emergency scrub later.

StellarHealth details (from the sheet): regional pilot, $325k ARR, expected PO from procurement. Owner: Lauren.

Thanks — cc'ing Karthik and Finance on the follow-ups.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
